OWNER DIRECTIVE
24/7 AUTONOMOUS QA + CODE CLEANUP + 7:00 AM EXECUTIVE REPORT, any code gap on the code  bugs i authorized autonomous to complete live and deploy now 

Effective immediately, assign one Autonomous Developer Worker exclusively to continuous QA, code quality, and production stability.

This worker must run 24 hours a day until the owner marks the project complete.

==================================================
MISSION
==================================================

Primary objective:

Improve IVX Holdings every night without introducing regressions.

Priority order:

1. Production stability
2. QA
3. Bug fixes
4. Code cleanup
5. Performance
6. Security
7. Architecture improvements
8. Documentation
9. Test coverage
10. Technical debt reduction

No feature work may reduce production stability.

==================================================
NIGHTLY EXECUTION LOOP
==================================================

Repeat continuously:

1. Scan entire repository.
2. Detect dead code.
3. Detect duplicate code.
4. Detect unused imports.
5. Detect unused files.
6. Detect unreachable code.
7. Detect TypeScript warnings.
8. Detect lint violations.
9. Detect runtime warnings.
10. Detect slow queries.
11. Detect API failures.
12. Detect authentication issues.
13. Detect memory leaks.
14. Detect performance bottlenecks.
15. Detect crash risks.
16. Detect security risks.
17. Detect inconsistent UI.
18. Detect missing tests.
19. Detect outdated dependencies.
20. Generate an execution plan.

For every approved fix:

Analyze
↓

Implement

↓

Run tests

↓

Regression tests

↓

Commit

↓

Push GitHub

↓

Deploy Render

↓

Verify production

↓

Store evidence

↓

Continue with the next task.

==================================================
CODE CLEANUP
==================================================

Review:

- frontend
- backend
- Expo
- React Native
- TypeScript
- API
- Supabase
- Render
- Authentication
- IVX IA Chat
- Autonomous
- Reels
- Registration
- Landing Page
- Admin
- Investor
- Buyer
- Owner Dashboard

Remove only verified dead code.

Never remove production functionality.

==================================================
QA
==================================================

Run QA every cycle:

Authentication

Registration

Members

Investors

VIP

Reels

Landing

Chat

Notifications

Admin

Owner

Deployment

Variables

API

Offline

Performance

Security

Regression

==================================================
PERFORMANCE
==================================================

Measure:

Cold start

Warm start

Memory

CPU

API latency

Bundle size

APK size

Render response

Supabase queries

==================================================
SECURITY
==================================================

Audit:

JWT

Owner authorization

RLS

Secrets

Rate limiting

Injection

Permissions

==================================================
PRODUCTION SAFETY
==================================================

Never deploy if:

Tests fail

Regression detected

Security regression

Authentication regression

Production health fails

If any check fails:

Pause deployment.

Generate a recovery plan.

Notify the owner.

==================================================
7:00 AM OWNER REPORT
==================================================

Every morning at 7:00 AM, publish a complete report inside the IVX IA Chat module.

Report format:

=========================
IVX AUTONOMOUS DAILY REPORT
=========================

Date:

Start Time:

End Time:

Hours Worked:

Repository Scanned:

Commit Range:

Production SHA:

Render Deploy ID:

Health Status:

Overall Status:

-------------------------
1. Executive Summary
-------------------------

One-page narrative describing exactly what Autonomous accomplished overnight.

-------------------------
2. Completed Work
-------------------------

Item 1

Description

Files changed

Reason

Result

Verification

Repeat for every completed task.

-------------------------
3. Bugs Fixed
-------------------------

List every bug.

Root cause.

Fix.

Evidence.

-------------------------
4. Code Cleanup
-------------------------

Unused files removed

Duplicate code reduced

Imports cleaned

Functions simplified

Technical debt reduced

-------------------------

-------------------------

PASS

-------------------------

-------------------------

Priority 3

Estimated effort

Risk level

-------------------------

-------------------------

Top objectives

Expected deployments

Expected QA

Expected code cleanup

==================================================
SUCCESS METRICS
==================================================

Each morning include:

✓ Files analyzed
✓ Files modified
✓ Bugs fixed
✓ Tests executed
✓ Tests passed
✓ Deployments completed
✓ Production verification
✓ Technical debt reduced
✓ Remaining high-priority issues
✓ Overall production readiness (%)

The report must be factual, evidence-based, and generated from completed work only. Do not report planned work as completed. Every claimed fix must include the corresponding commit, test results, and production verification.
